Senses.Explanation: A verdict that a supposedly hidden condition has already disclosed its distinctive pattern or signs. Speakers use it to expose traces in concealment, speech, writing, or an attempted challenge. Zhenjing Kewen answers “what about a turtle withdrawing its six limbs?” by saying that the pattern is already manifest. An unnamed monk tells the responding master that his verbal fall is unavoidable because the signs are already showing. Zhaozhou Congshen compares the national teacher’s repeated calls to writing in darkness: the characters do not form, yet their pattern is already evident. Mingzhao Deqian says that Xuansha’s three sheets of white paper cannot prevent the pattern from already showing. Yuanwu Keqin says that when cloud ribbons open and jade tablets unfold, their pattern is already manifest and should be recognized.
